actions.body: Final thought before June 1: the table is precise and the framing is partnership, but precision without an exit and partnership without a vote is just a well-formatted bill. See you on the other side.

actions.title: The hobby tier is gone, and that was the point
actions.body: STARDUST going 4x kills the exact use case that made Scaleway lovable for tinkerers. Enterprises won't blink at 2%. Hobbyists feel 400%. Different customers, different pain, same announcement.
Three rounds in and nobody from Scaleway has answered the only question that matters to my clients: what does leaving cost? Price transparency without exit transparency is half a disclosure.
Locked my H100 reservation through May. After June 1 I re-evaluate against the hyperscalers, because 10% on premium was already the whole margin conversation. Sovereignty is nice; runway is nicer.
